name: Oat Milk
siboNotes: Contains fructans from oats which may feed bacterial overgrowth. Start with small portions and monitor tolerance during SIBO treatment phases.
preparationTips: Look for oat milk without added high-FODMAP ingredients like apple juice or inulin
Shake well before use as natural separation occurs
Use smaller portions in coffee or tea to stay within low-FODMAP limits
Consider diluting with water if using larger amounts in recipes
nutritionalHighlights: Often fortified with calcium and vitamin D
Good source of B vitamins when fortified
